en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Hasan b. `Abdullah b. Sa`id narrated to us. He said: `Abd al-`Aziz b. Yahya narrated to us. He said: Al-Ash`ath b. Muhammad al-Dabi narrated to us. He said: Shu`ayb b. `Umar narrated to me from his father from Jabir al-Ju`fi.

He said: I visited Abi Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali (as), and his brother Zayd (as) was with him. Ma`ruf b. Kharbudh al-Makki entered, so Abu Ja`far (as) said: O Ma`ruf! Recite one of your poems for me. So, he recited:
